component.name: AFFiNITe
component.summary: Local-first workspace for docs, whiteboards, Kanban boards, LaTeX, and AI

description.p: AFFiNITe is a privacy-focused, local-first personal knowledge management and productivity workspace designed for Linux and cross-platform environments. It combines documents, edgeless whiteboards, databases, Kanban boards, calendar planning, LaTeX scientific writing, Mermaid diagramming, and local AI into a unified offline-first application.

ul.li: Rich block-based documents and infinite Edgeless whiteboards powered by BlockSuite and Yjs CRDTs
Mermaid Pro Suite with live split-view editor, dark mode theming, templates, and SVG export
Daily and ISO Weekly Notes integrated with a native Monthly and Weekly Calendar planner
Native Kanban Project Boards with due date synchronization and progress tracking
Scientific LaTeX editor with live KaTeX preview, BibTeX management, and PDF compilation
Zero-API-key AI integration supporting Google Antigravity CLI (agy), local CLI models, and Ollama

description.p: Release v0.31.0: Full AFFiNITe Integration Hub (pure domain core in affinite-hub with bidirectional CRDT mutations for habits, calendar, and boards, unified reminder engine with Web Audio acoustic synthesis, weekly intelligence snapshots with 50/50 balance scoring, and workspace context injection into local AI copilot), Hábitos v2 (flexible recurrence engine with daily, weekdays, interval, and weekly-count patterns, expanded catalog of 210 icons across 14 categories and 60 colors with WCAG contrast, schedule-aware streaks and consistency, and clean removal of legacy editor slash habits), and comprehensive mobile route integration.

Release v0.30.0: Full AFFiNE Design System unification (Vanilla Extract .css.ts + cssVarV2 tokens with native Light and Dark mode across Boards, Calendar, Habits, Streaks, Weekly Reports, Journals, and AI Hub), Streaks and Countdowns with Web Audio API harmonic chime and exact pause/resume shifting, interactive Habit Card editor block (<affine-habit-preview>) with live Yjs sync, Calendar v2 with visual time-blocking and annual/tasks views, and removal of legacy Planka/OIDC and Anx-Remix subsystems.

Release v0.29.0: Native Flatpak bundle, offline SQLite blob mirror, single-renderer lightweight tabs, Linux Wayland GPU acceleration and Hyprland blank screen fix, Mermaid Pro Suite, ISO Weekly Notes, Weekly Reports Hub, supercharged Calendar Planner, Habits tracking suite with date sync, and zero-API-key Google Antigravity and Ollama AI integration.

Added Mermaid Pro Suite with live split editor and templates, ISO Weekly Notes, native Monthly and Weekly Calendar planner synced with Kanban Boards, and zero-API-key Antigravity CLI and Ollama AI integration.
